summary: Tested 'wallet + crypto for the rest' (split payment) on the backend and in the UI. Business Line checkout and extra-number checkout with a $10 wallet: the 'Wallet + crypto for the rest' option is preselected, its subtitle and the split note are correct, the Top up link is still shown, the Pay button reads 'Pay $40.00 with BTC' ($15.00 for an extra number), the order header shows the '$10.00 from your wallet + $X in crypto' split and 'Send exactly' shows X. A full simulated payment makes the number active, and the wallet ends at 10+X-price. A short payment (API, $5) sets the order to failed with the 'everything is in your wallet' message; nothing is bought and the wallet gets the $5. There is no Finish button any more. Plan upgrade: the button reads 'Pay the $52.50 rest with crypto', the split note shows, and the order uses the wallet part; a full payment upgrades to Pro and the wallet ends at 0. Campaign 'needs Pro' nudge: short line, 'Top up instead' links to ?need=52.5, the crypto button covers only the rest (CryptoPay rounds the address up to $53). The nudge has 2 bugs (see below). Shared WalletPay/ShortNote screens checked: Quick call, Renew now, Replace number, Landline texting setup. Each shows a Top up link and one '-crypto-open' button for the rest; no screen had 2 crypto buttons. Regressions pass: a wallet-covered checkout reads 'Pay $50.00 & activate'; a zero balance gives full-price 'Pay with crypto'; a mocked 400 checkout error shows a toast and buy-error; ?prep=menu shows ivr-unsaved-pill. Backend: 7/7 new tests and texting bundle JS 12/12 pass.

minor.issue: UpgradePay.js always sends useWallet:true. When the wallet already covers the upgrade and the user picks 'Pay with crypto', split() takes the whole charge from the wallet (walletPart 62.5) and asks for only the $10 minimum in crypto. Reproduced: wallet $100, Starter→Pro gives walletPart=62.5, price=10. The user meant to pay with crypto but is charged from the wallet. Fix: send useWallet only when the wallet is short and has money (!enough && balance > 0), like Checkout.js does.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening or refreshing /cloudivr/app/campaigns/new directly leaves the nudge stuck on 'Checking the price…'; no /upgrade quote request is ever sent. It works when you get there from inside the app (from /app/campaigns). RCA: `useState(cands[0]?.phoneNumber || '')` runs before the catalog loads. With no catalog the plan order is empty, so cands is empty, phone stays '' and the quote effect never runs. Fix: add useEffect(() => { if (!phone && cands[0]) setPhone(cands[0].phoneNumber) }, [cands, phone]), or work out the phone from cands when phone is empty.

campaign-upgrade-note is still partly English in French: 'Payé depuis votre portefeuille. Includes $12.50 credit for the rest of this month. Then $100.00/month.' RCA: the fr.json/es.json keys " Includes {0} credit for the rest of this month." and " Then {0}/month." start with a space. tr() in i18n/engine.js trims the text before looking it up, and compile() builds a regex with the space at the start (^ Includes…$), so these keys never match. Fix: remove the leading spaces from the keys and values in fr.json and es.json (tr() keeps the surrounding whitespace by itself).

issues: When the missing amount is below the $10 crypto minimum, the button still says 'Pay the $0.50 rest with crypto' (Quick call with a $0.50 wallet), but the address it opens is for $10. UpgradePay shows 'Pay the $Y rest' even when the backend deposit is max(Y,10). Show the real amount: 'Pay $10.00 with crypto (minimum; the rest stays in your wallet)'.
The campaign nudge note says 'Paid from your wallet.' while the user is paying the rest with crypto. It should match the split wording.

action_items: UpgradeNudge.js: set phone once cands are available (stuck 'Checking the price…' on direct load or refresh of /app/campaigns/new)

fr.json / es.json: remove the leading spaces from the keys ' Includes {0} credit for the rest of this month.' and ' Then {0}/month.' (and any other keys that start with a space) so the nudge note is fully translated
UpgradePay.js: send useWallet only when !enough && balance > 0, so 'Pay with crypto' with a wallet that already covers the upgrade does not quietly charge the wallet
Optional: when the missing amount is under the $10 minimum, crypto 'rest' buttons should show the $10 they will actually ask for
critical_code_review_comments: orders.js activate(): the short-payment check is wallet balance < need at settle time. If the user tops up separately, or already has other money in the wallet, a short crypto payment still completes the purchase from that other money. This is acceptable, but the rule 'short → nothing bought' really means 'short with the wallet included'.

orders.js split(): when the wallet already covers the total and useWallet is true, deposit = MIN_TOPUP, so the order becomes a $10 top-up plus a full wallet charge. The frontend should never send useWallet in that case (Checkout.js doesn't; UpgradePay.js does).

CryptoPay rounds the missing amount up to whole dollars (Math.ceil): $52.50 becomes a $53 address while the button says $52.50. The leftover stays in the wallet, so this is minor, but the copy differs.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (core split flows pass; nudge stuck on direct load; FR note partly untranslated)

rca of the issue: Nudge stuck: UpgradeNudge.js line 16 sets phone from cands only once, on first render, before the shell catalog has loaded, so the quote effect (phone && need) never runs.
